doc.title: Why review matters
doc.content:
Why review matters

Reviewing a change is harder than making one. A diff shows what moved, but not whether it should have.

Every edit is a claim about the reader.

So a reviewer does two jobs at once: check the facts, and judge the prose.

  • Check the facts
  • Judge the prose

proposal.summary: Tightened the opening paragraph, made the blockquote concrete, and added a third review duty.
proposal.rationale: The opening was abstract, and the list under-represented the work.
proposal.content:
Why review matters

Reviewing a change is harder than making one. A diff shows what moved, but never whether it should have moved at all.

Every edit is a claim about a reader who is not in the room.

So a reviewer does two jobs at once: check the facts, and judge the prose.

  • Check the facts
  • Judge the prose
  • Say what is missing
